basic_info.description:
Incredible views at Madrone available now! If you're going to SIP / WFH, why not do so with space, views, and a balcony? This two bedroom, two bathroom home offers over 1,300 square feet of living space with a large en-suite primary bedroom and a spacious guest bedroom with a large walk-in closet. The open living, kitchen, and dining room is perfect for staying in or entertaining with views of the city, bay, and Bay Bridge. Relax in the evening while enjoying the city lights from the comfort of your couch. This home is available partially furnished and includes in-unit laundry, 1 car parking, and an additional storage unit.

Owner pays for all utilities except PG&E, cable, and internet service. Tenant pays for move-in and move-out fees.
